dsn.description: A connection URL or a keyword/value connection string.

tables.description: The tables to offer as streams. Empty: every table in the schema.

chunkRows.description: Rows per query on a table with a primary key; each chunk ends at a resume point.

batchBytes.description: Approximate bytes of values per Arrow batch.

publication.description: The publication that tables read with cdc are in. Created, or given the tables it lacks, if the user may.

slot.description: The replication slot tables read with cdc are read through. Default: one named after the pipeline, openetl_<pipeline>.

snapshotChunkRows.description: Rows per chunk of a cdc table's snapshot, which is held in memory until the log catches up with it.
